author: implementation agent (recording decisions given by the User)
note: These are READINESS decisions taken BEFORE P7 begins. They authorise no P7 implementation, create no P7 deliverable, and approve no phase. They resolve the ambiguities in REC-PHASES-0001 and convert them into explicit, testable prerequisites.
precedent: D-P6-1 established that the authoritative roadmap defines phase meaning. D-P7-A applies that rule to dependencies rather than reinterpreting them.

decisions.title: P7 dependencies refer to authoritative roadmap phase numbers
decisions.decision: Roadmap P7 'Dependencies: P2, P3' is interpreted as the authoritative roadmap phase numbers, not the executed-phase numbers.
decisions.rationale: The roadmap is the authoritative definition of phase meaning, per D-P6-1. Executed numbering diverges from the roadmap for P2 through P5 and must not be used to satisfy a roadmap dependency.
decisions.consequence: P7 prerequisites are roadmap P2 and roadmap P3 as the roadmap defines them, evaluated against the roadmap's own acceptance criteria.
decisions.bounded_scope: Interpretation only. Authorises no work and waives nothing.

approval.basis: Explicit User decision: 'D-P7-A: Interpret P7 Dependencies: P2, P3 as the authoritative roadmap phase numbers, not executed-phase numbers.'

decisions.title: Roadmap P3 is not waived and must be satisfied before P7
decisions.decision: Roadmap P3 (Agent Interoperability) is NOT waived. It must be satisfied before P7 begins.
decisions.rationale: Roadmap P3 is a stated P7 prerequisite under D-P7-A. Its acceptance is unmet: one DECLARED generic adapter and no portability conformance test. Waiving a stated prerequisite without an explicit rationale would silently reduce the roadmap's guarantees.
required_before_p7: real adapters beyond the single DECLARED 'generic' adapter
a portability conformance test proving that deleting all adapters leaves the core validators passing
roadmap P3 acceptance: a fresh agent can resume the project from repository state alone
decisions.bounded_scope: Roadmap P3 satisfaction only. Does not authorise starting roadmap P3 work, which needs its own User authorisation.

approval.basis: Explicit User decision: 'D-P7-B: Do not waive roadmap P3. Record that Roadmap P3 must be satisfied before P7 begins, including the required real adapters and portability test.'

decisions.title: Retire global memory is narrowed to the SPS 2.0 project-local boundary
decisions.decision: Roadmap P7's 'retire global memory' objective is narrowed to the SPS 2.0 project-local boundary ONLY.
decisions.rationale: Retiring a global mechanism broadly would require modifying or removing the legacy installers that perform it. Legacy SPS modification is prohibited and the legacy-diff-zero invariant must be preserved. The objective is narrowed rather than waived, so it stays meaningful without breaching that boundary.
explicitly_narrowed: in scope: global-memory references and mechanisms inside SPS 2.0 project-local artefacts
out of scope: legacy install.sh, uninstall.sh, get-sps.sh and every other legacy artefact
out of scope: any change that would make the legacy diff non-zero
decisions.required_assertion: No claim may be made that legacy global memory has been retired.
decisions.bounded_scope: SPS 2.0 project-local artefacts only. Legacy remains untouched; legacy diff must remain 0.

approval.basis: Explicit User decision: 'D-P7-C: Narrow retire global memory to the SPS 2.0 project-local boundary only. Do not modify legacy install.sh, uninstall.sh, get-sps.sh, or any other legacy artefact. Preserve the legacy-diff-zero invariant. Do not claim legacy global memory has been retired.'

decisions.title: A threat model is required before P7 implementation begins
decisions.decision: A threat model MUST exist before P7 implementation begins.
decisions.rationale: Roadmap P4 lists a threat model as a deliverable and it is absent. P7 introduces persistent project state, the first phase whose primary output is durable state. Introducing state without a threat model defers the security review to the point where it is most expensive.
required_before_p7: a written threat model covering persistent project-local state
explicit treatment of isolation between two projects
explicit treatment of rollback of the memory layout
decisions.bounded_scope: Threat model content only. Authoring it requires its own User authorisation; this decision only makes it a prerequisite.

approval.basis: Explicit User decision: 'D-P7-D: Require a threat model before P7 implementation begins, because P7 introduces persistent project state.'

carried_forward_unchanged.CONF-001: UNRESOLVED. LCP and INP thresholds remain NOT_OBSERVED. No value may be invented or inferred.

what_these_decisions_do_not_authorise: installing any dependency, skill, MCP, CLI or package
beginning roadmap P3 work or any phase beyond P7
